// diagnostic

E0804

Self-recursive lambda binding

What

Self-recursive lambda binding

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0804

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0804: tests/ui/lambda_self_rec.stderr.

Error [E0804]: a lambda can't call itself as `f`
  --> tests/ui/lambda_self_rec.jet:1:17
    |
  1 | fn run() { f :: (x: Int) -> f(x) }
    |                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: short functions stored in a binding can't recurse in v1
 Fix: write a named `fn` instead of assigning the lambda to `f`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0804

Error [E0102]: nothing named `f` exists here
  --> tests/ui/lambda_self_rec.jet:1:29
    |
  1 | fn run() { f :: (x: Int) -> f(x) }
    |                             ^
 Why: only functions that have been defined (or built in, like `print` / `input`) can be called
 Fix: define it first (fn f() { ... }), or call one that exists
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0102
